The '''2024–25 Super League Greece''', also known as '''Stoiximan Super League''' for sponsorship reasons,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://emea.gr/epicheiriseis/684198/stoiximan-kentrikos-chorigos-tis-super-league-gia-epomena-25-chronia|title=Stoiximan: Κεντρικός χορηγός της Super League για επόμενα 2,5 χρόνια|date=16 December 2022|lang=el|location=Online}}</ref> was the 89th season of the [[Super League Greece]], the top Greek professional league for association football clubs, since its establishment as a national championship under the supervision of the Hellenic Football Federation (HFF) in 1927, the 66th championship since the establishment of the 1st National Division in 1959 and the 19th under its current name. [[PAOK FC|PAOK]] were the defending champions, having won their 4th title the previous season.

This season was the first to use [[semi-automated offside technology]] and goal-line technology, as Super League clubs unanimously agreed to their introduction. The technologies were introduced for the first time in the Championship play-offs this season and were also used in the [[2025 Greek Football Cup final|2025 Greek Cup final]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/stoiximan-super-league-etsi-tha-leitourgoun-to-imiaftomato-ofsaint-kai-to-goal-line-technology/|title=Stoiximan Super League: Έτσι θα λειτουργούν το ημιαυτόματο οφσάιντ και το goal line technology στα Playoffs 1-4 και στον τελικό του Κυπέλλου Ελλάδας|date=26 March 2025|lang=el|location=Online}}</ref>

The season began on 17 August 2024 and went into a 3-week break after the conclusion of the regular season (26th Matchday). The second phase of the league, Championship play-offs, Europe play-offs and Relegation play-outs, continued on 29 March 2025. The final matches of the season were played on 22 May 2025.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.slgr.gr/el/article/programma-stoiximan-super-league-playoffs-1-4-5-8-kai-playouts/|title=Πρόγραμμα Stoiximan Super League Playoffs 1-4, 5-8 και Playouts|date=12 March 2025|lang=el|location=Online}}</ref> 

The draw for the fixtures took place on Tuesday 16 July at 21:00 local time and the whole schedule for the regular season was released shortly after.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.slgr.gr/el/article/klerose-protathlematos-stoiximan-super-league-2024-25/|title=Κλήρωση Πρωταθλήματος Stoiximan Super League 2024-25|date=16 July 2024|lang=el|location=Online}}</ref> 

[[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] secured the 48th title in their history on 13 April 2025, after defeating [[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]] by 1–0, at home in the third matchday of the Championship play-offs, the winning their first title after the [[2021–22 Super League Greece|2021–22]] season.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.slgr.gr/el/article/protathletes-gia-48e-phora-o-olumpiakos/|title=Πρωταθλητής για 48η φορά ο Ολυμπιακός|date=14 April 2025|website=slgr.gr|lang=el|location=Online}}</ref>

==Teams==
Fourteen teams competed in the league – the top twelve teams from the previous season and two teams promoted from [[2023-24 Super League Greece 2|Super League 2]]. [[Levadiakos F.C.|Levadiakos]] returned in the [[Super League Greece|Super League]] after a one-year absence and the [[2022–23 Super League Greece|2022–23]] season.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/super-league-2-o-levadeiakos-epestrepse-sti-stoiximan-super-league.10302160.html|title=Super League 2: Ο Λεβαδειακός επέστρεψε στην Stoiximan Super League|website=sport24.gr|date=20 April 2024|lang=el|location=Online}}</ref> [[Athens Kallithea F.C.|Athens Kallithea]] played in the Super League for the first time after 18 years.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/athens-kallithea-chania-1-1-pire-to-chryso-vathmo-kai-anevike-sti-stoiximan-super-league-meta-apo-16-chronia-i-kallithea.10312385.html|title=Kαλλιθέα - Χανιά 1-1: Πήρε τον "χρυσό βαθμό" και ανέβηκε στη Stoiximan Super League μετά από 18 χρόνια|date=9 May 2024|lang=el|location=Online}}</ref> [[PAS Giannina F.C.|PAS Giannina]] were relegated to Super League 2 for the first time, after 4 consecutive years playing in the top division.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/stoiximan-super-league-o-pas-ypovivastike-epeita-apo-tessera-chronia.10302416.html|title=Stoiximan Super League: Ο ΠΑΣ υποβιβάστηκε έπειτα από τέσσερα χρόνια|date=20 April 2024|lang=el|location=Online}}</ref> [[A.E. Kifisia F.C.|A.E. Kifisia]] were relegated to Super League 2 after only one year in the Super League.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/kifisia-pas-giannina-2-3-oi-ipeirotes-nikisan-toys-neofotistoys-kai-toys-piran-mazi-toys-sti-super-league-2.10306851.html|title=Κηφισιά - ΠΑΣ Γιάννινα 2-3: Οι Ηπειρώτες νίκησαν τους νεοφώτιστους και τους πήραν μαζί τους στη Super League 2|date=27 April 2024|lang=el|location=Online}}</ref>

===Format===
The championship was held in two phases, namely the regular season (phase 1) and then the Championship play-offs with the top 4 teams, the play-offs for the [[UEFA Conference League|UEFA Conference League 2025–26]] qualifying rounds between the teams ranked 5 through 8 and the Relegation play-outs round with the bottom 6 teams (phase 2). In the regular season 26 matches were played in 2 rounds of 13 match days each, where in each round all teams competed against all others based on a draw. 

====Championship Play-offs round====
After the end of the regular season, the teams ranked 1 through 4 participated in the Championship play-offs, to determine the winner of the league and how the places for next year's [[UEFA]] Competitions were split among those 4 teams, based on their final positions. The 4 teams that entered this round kept the total points that they won during the regular season.

The Championship play-offs were held on six game days, i.e. in two rounds of three games each, where in each round all teams competed against all others, based on a draw. The champion (of those that participated in this round) was the team that gained the most points during the regular season and the Championship play-offs combined.

====Europe Play-offs round====
After the end of the regular season, the teams ranked 5 through 8 participated in the Europe play-offs, to determine the last available spot for next year's [[UEFA Conference League]] 2nd qualifying round, assuming that the [[2024–25 Greek Football Cup|2024–25 Greek Cup]] winner finished in the top 4, since [[Super League Greece|Super League]] is entitled to 5 entrants in 2025-26 [[UEFA]] Competitions.

The Europe play-offs were held on six game days, i.e. in two rounds of three games each, where in each round all teams competed against all others, based on a draw. The last available European spot was given to the team (of those that participated in this round) that after the completion of the play-offs, finished in 5th place. The 4 teams that entered this round, did so with half the points they won during the regular season.

====Relegation Play-outs round====
After the end of the regular season, the teams ranked 9 through 14 participated in the Relegation play-outs, to determine the 2 teams that were relegated to next year's [[Super League Greece 2|Super League 2]].

The Relegation play-outs were held over ten game days i.e. in two rounds of five games each, where in each round all teams competed against all others, based on a draw. The 6 teams that entered this round, kept the total points that they won during the regular season. Positions 9 through 14 were determined by the total points the teams, participating in the play-outs, had earned cumulatively during the regular season and the play-outs. The last two teams were relegated to Super League 2.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.sport24.gr/football/stoiximan-super-league-ayto-einai-to-neo-systima-diexagogis-toy-protathlimatos-2024-25.10348445.html|title=Stoiximan Super League: Αυτό είναι το νέο σύστημα διεξαγωγής του πρωταθλήματος 2024/25|date=10 July 2024|lang=el|location=Online}}</ref>

==Positions by round==
The table lists the positions of teams after each week of matches. To preserve chronological evolvements, any postponed matches are not included in the round at which they were originally scheduled, but added to the full round they were played immediately afterwards. For example, if a match is scheduled for round 13, but then postponed and played between rounds 16 and 17, it will be added to the standings for round 16. Juridical decisions regarding a match are also added to the full round after which they were ruled.

==Europe play-offs==
The teams ranked 5 through 8 from the regular season participated in the Europe play-offs to determine the last available spot for [[2025–26 UEFA Conference League]], which was awarded to the 5th placed team because the [[2024–25 Greek Football Cup|2024–25 Greek Cup]] winner, Olympiacos, finished in the top 4. The teams met twice (6 matches per team) and entered this round with half the points they earned during the regular season.

==Relegation play-outs==
